title: Graduation Project Thesis: AstraIPS
description: Fog-native, two-layer MQTT intrusion prevention on a Raspberry Pi 5: Snort 3 with a custom Lua preprocessor plus a BiLSTM classifier.
longDescription: AstraIPS addresses application-layer command injection threats in MQTT-based IoT networks through a fog-native, two-layer inline intrusion prevention system running on a Raspberry Pi 5. The first layer is Snort 3 with a custom MQTT-aware Lua preprocessor for protocol-aware parsing and signature detection; the second is a sequence-aware BiLSTM classifier that catches novel and obfuscated payloads. A four-stage, per-device enforcement policy escalates from flag, to alert, to packet drop, to MAC quarantine. Evaluation showed 97.7% mean 5-fold accuracy (AUC 0.991), 29 ms AI inference and only 2.5% CPU usage on the edge device. The thesis won 1st Place Overall out of 89 projects at the UOWD Research Competition (2026), and the thesis article has been accepted in IEEE Access.
